releaseNotes:
EasyBank is here: transactions, loans, repayments, and an account summary. Plus TalkBack actions for warehouse boxes.

New in 3.1: EasyBank
Open EasyBank on the Computer to see your available cash and manage your money.
Transactions lists every money movement, newest first: market orders, bill payments, loans, and loan repayments. Each one reads its amount, day, and transaction number.
BillDesk receipts now share their transaction numbers with EasyBank.
Take a loan of 10,000 rupees at 5 percent, 25,000 rupees at 8 percent, or 50,000 rupees at 12 percent. Loans are repaid in 4, 6, or 8 weekly installments, and you can have one loan at a time.
Repay Loan shows your remaining balance, remaining interest, installments left, and the next due day. Pay one installment or the full loan. If you cannot afford it, you hear Insufficient funds.
Account Summary shows available cash, total income, total expenses, outstanding loan, bills paid, and market purchases.
The daily reminder on the Shop Floor now also tells you when a loan installment is due.

New in 3.1: Fixes
Warehouse boxes now offer TalkBack actions: Open Box and Carry Box for sealed boxes, Take Packets and Carry Box for opened boxes, and Throw Away for empty boxes.
A box's page also offers the same TalkBack actions on its status text.

Coming next
Customers who buy from your racks.
HireNow, for hiring employees.

Open Settings, What's New after updating to read everything added in 3.0 and 3.1.
